topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band, beam management strategies must adapt to the increased path loss and reduced wavelength. Narrower beams in higher frequency bands limit the effective spread of rays, increasing the impact of phase noise on demodulation. Efficient channel estimation and tracking techniques are necessary to adapt to rapidly changing channel conditions. Considering the selectivity properties of beamformed equivalent channels, machine learning-based beamforming can be employed to adaptively adjust beamforming parameters in real-time, improving spectral efficiency. This approach can mitigate gain variance and phase noise impact, ensuring optimal performance in the 57-66 GHz band.
